name: Import Code-Signing Certificates
description: Imports a PKCS12 certificate and private key into a macOS Keychain.

keychain.description: The name of the keychain to import into.

create-keychain.description: A boolean indicating whether to create the keychain.

keychain-password.description: The password to use with the keychain. Gets auto-generated if keychain is "signing_temp".

p12-filepath.description: The path to the PKCS12 file to import.

p12-file-base64.description: The certificates in a PKCS12 file encoded as a base64 string.

p12-password.description: The password used to import the PKCS12 file.
